title: The Locked Room
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
ciphertext: TBX BYGMH TNQM A FNAK GB RBS GTNG XTMH RBS TNQM MCAEAHNGMK GTM AEUBFFAJCM XTNGMQMV VMENAHF, TBXMQMV AEUVBJNJCM, ESFG JM GTM GVSGT?
plaintext: How often have I said to you that when you have eliminated the impossible whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth?
epilogue: Holmes says it at Pondicherry Lodge, over Bartholomew Sholto's body. He has already worked out that one intruder climbed in through the window. For the second, the door, the window and the chimney are all ruled out, which leaves the one way in nobody thought to check: a trapdoor to the roof.
